metadata.description: Real South African destinations with fictional hotels and mock booking data.
metadata.hotelImageNote: Stock images are illustrative and do not depict these fictional hotels. Some photos are reused.
metadata.priceNote: Mock prices in ZAR per room per night, inclusive of demo taxes; no extra demo fees.
metadata.inventoryNote: totalRooms is static inventory, not date-specific availability. Subtract overlapping bookings per room type to calculate availability.
metadata.ratingsNote: All hotel stars, scores and review counts are fictional.
metadata.imageNote: Remote images require internet access. City images carry source-page credit/licence instructions. Hotel image URLs have not been checked for current availability.
